question_cn: 后对光杆王，为什么还需要己方王的配合？
question_en: In queen vs. lone king, why is your own king still needed?

options.text_cn: 后太强，不需要王，可以单独将死
options.text_en: The queen is too strong and can checkmate alone

options.text_cn: 王负责封堵逃跑路线，与后配合完成将死
options.text_en: The king cuts off escape routes and cooperates with the queen for checkmate

options.text_cn: 王只需要站在中心保护后
options.text_en: The king just stays in the center to protect the queen
To prevent the enemy king from attacking the queen

explanation_cn: 后虽然强大，但将死需要己方王封堵。『后打、王封』是后对王的基本元思维。单后将死容易陷入逼和（stalemate）陷阱，王的配合是关键。
explanation_en: Queen gives check, king cuts off escape: this is the meta-pattern. Queen alone risks stalemate — king cooperation is essential.
